unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "A Nano (XNO) rail gives the compliance layer an on-ledger audit trail it does not have to trust" on julleycode/payguard. Argued the 3-layer anomaly pipeline gets on-ledger features (velocity/amount/novelty) from public blocks instead of a database row; sub-cent amounts without fee pollution; compromised-wallet payouts independently readable. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO) as a nano:mainnet rail to feed the pipeline. Disclosed public research. One issue per target.
